	/* Shared publication-date ordering for the news page and homepage ticker. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (window.cecOrderNews) return;

  function storyId(record) {
    var match = new URL(record.href, window.location.href).pathname.match(/-(\d+)\/?$/);
    return match ? Number(match[1]) : 0;
  }

  function publicationDate(doc) {
    var metadata = doc.querySelector('meta[property="article:published_time"], [itemprop="datePublished"]');
    var value = metadata && (metadata.getAttribute('content') || metadata.getAttribute('datetime') || metadata.textContent);
    var parsed = value ? Date.parse(value) : NaN;
    if (Number.isFinite(parsed)) return parsed;
    var author = doc.querySelector('article .authorName');
    var match = author && author.textContent.match(/Published on:\s*([A-Za-z]+\s+\d{1,2},\s+\d{4})/i);
    return match ? Date.parse(match[1]) : NaN;
  }

  window.cecOrderNews = function (records) {
    var pending = records.slice();
    function next() {
      var record = pending.shift();
      if (!record) return Promise.resolve();
      var url = new URL(record.href, window.location.href);
      if (url.origin !== window.location.origin || !/^\/story-/.test(url.pathname)) return next();
      var controller = new AbortController();
      var timeout = window.setTimeout(function () { controller.abort(); }, 5000);
      return fetch(url.pathname, { credentials: 'omit', cache: 'no-store', signal: controller.signal })
        .then(function (response) {
          if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Article unavailable');
          return response.text();
        })
        .then(function (html) {
          record.publishedAt = publicationDate(new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html'));
        })
        .catch(function () { /* Keep the article available if its date cannot be read. */ })
        .finally(function () { window.clearTimeout(timeout); })
        .then(next);
    }
    // Bound concurrent requests; fetch only stories already visible on the public list.
    return Promise.all([next(), next(), next(), next()]).then(function () {
      return records.sort(function (a, b) {
        var aDate = Number.isFinite(a.publishedAt) ? a.publishedAt : -Infinity;
        var bDate = Number.isFinite(b.publishedAt) ? b.publishedAt : -Infinity;
        if (aDate !== bDate) return aDate > bDate ? -1 : 1;
        return storyId(b) - storyId(a);
      });
    });
  };
})();

<!-- Automatic homepage news ticker -->
<script>
	/* Fill the existing homepage ticker from Bushel's public Local News list. */
	(function()
	{
		'use strict';
		if (!/^(?:\/|\/default\.aspx)?$/i.test(window.location.pathname)) return;

		function initNewsTicker()
		{
			var ticker = document.querySelector('.cec-ticker');
			var track = ticker && ticker.querySelector('[data-ticker-track]');
			if (!track || ticker.classList.contains('cec-ticker--live')) return;
			ticker.classList.add('cec-ticker--live', 'cec-ticker--static');
			var controller = new AbortController();
			var timeout = window.setTimeout(function()
			{
				controller.abort();
			}, 10000);
			var resizeObserver;

			function render(items)
			{
				if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.disconnect();
				var group = document.createElement('div');
				group.className = 'cec-ticker__group';
				items.forEach(function(item)
				{
					var link = document.createElement('a');
					link.className = 'cec-ticker__item';
					link.href = item.href;
					var text = document.createElement('span');
					text.textContent = item.title;
					link.appendChild(text);
					group.appendChild(link);
				});
				track.replaceChildren(group);
				var oldButton = ticker.querySelector('.cec-ticker__pause');
				if (oldButton) oldButton.remove();
				var viewport = ticker.querySelector('.cec-ticker__viewport');

				var repeat = group.cloneNode(true);
				repeat.classList.add('cec-ticker__group--repeat');
				repeat.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
				repeat.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link)
				{
					link.tabIndex = -1;
				});
				track.appendChild(repeat);

				function updateMotion()
				{
					if (!viewport) return;
					var available = viewport.clientWidth;
					var content = group.getBoundingClientRect().width;
					// Begin with visible headlines; repeat only when the first set overflows.
					ticker.classList.toggle('cec-ticker--static', content <= available + 1);
					track.style.setProperty('--cec-live-distance', content + 'px');
					track.style.setProperty('--cec-live-duration', Math.max(20, content / 45) + 's');
				}
				updateMotion();
				if (window.ResizeObserver && viewport)
				{
					resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(updateMotion);
					resizeObserver.observe(viewport);
					resizeObserver.observe(group);
				}
			}
			var fallback = [
			{
				title: 'View all news and announcements',
				href: '/storylist-764'
			}];
			// Never present old manual headlines as current news during a failed request.
			render(fallback);
			fetch('/storylist-764',
				{
					credentials: 'omit',
					cache: 'no-store',
					signal: controller.signal
				})
				.then(function(response)
				{
					if (!response.ok) throw new Error('News list unavailable');
					return response.text();
				})
				.then(function(html)
				{
					var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(html, 'text/html');
					var items = [];
					var seen = Object.create(null);
					doc.querySelectorAll('#featured .ui-tabs-panel, .storyCategory .story-list > li').forEach(function(row)
					{
						var link = row.querySelector('.info h2 a, a.storyListTnA, .storyListTnA a, h2 a, h3 a') || row.querySelector('a[href*="/story-"]');
						if (!link) return;
						var url;
						try
						{
							url = new URL(link.getAttribute('href'), window.location.origin + '/storylist-764');
						}
						catch (error)
						{
							return;
						}
						var title = link.textContent.trim() || (row.querySelector('img') ||
						{}).alt;
						if (!title || url.origin !== window.location.origin || !url.pathname.startsWith('/story-') || seen[url.pathname]) return;
						seen[url.pathname] = true;
						// Use the public article path, without preview or tracking parameters.
						items.push(
						{
							title: title,
							href: url.pathname
						});
					});
					return window.cecOrderNews(items).then(function (ordered)
					{
						render(ordered.length ? ordered : fallback);
					});
				})
				.catch(function()
				{
					render(fallback);
				})
				.finally(function()
				{
					window.clearTimeout(timeout);
				});
		}
		if (document.readyState === 'loading')
		{
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initNewsTicker,
			{
				once: true
			});
		}
		else
		{
			initNewsTicker();
		}
	})();

</script>

<script>
	/* Group display-only crop years; retain CMS bid nodes, values, and chart handlers. */
	(function()
	{
		'use strict';
		if (!/^\/cashbids(?:single)?-/i.test(window.location.pathname)) return;
		var scheduled = false;
		var observer;
		var labels = {
			corn: 'Corn',
			'red wheat': 'Red Wheat',
			'white wheat': 'White Wheat',
			soybeans: 'Soybeans'
		};

		function groupBids()
		{
			scheduled = false;
			if (observer) observer.disconnect();
			try
			{
				var panel = document.getElementById('ctl00_MainContent_ctl00_BidsResponsivePanel');
				if (!panel) return;
				// Keep the signup outside the bids panel so live price refreshes do not erase it.
				if (/^\/cashbidssingle-\/?$/i.test(window.location.pathname))
				{
					panel.classList.add('cec-has-bid-signup');
					var signup = document.getElementById('cec-cash-bid-signup');
					if (!signup)
					{
						signup = document.createElement('div');
						signup.id = 'cec-cash-bid-signup';
						var link = document.createElement('a');
						link.href = 'https://www.coopelev.com/site-registration';
						link.textContent = 'Sign up to receive cash bid updates from Cooperative Elevator!';
						signup.appendChild(link);
					}
					if (panel.nextElementSibling !== signup) panel.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', signup);
				}
				panel.querySelectorAll('.cashBidLocation').forEach(function(location)
				{
					var commodities = Object.create(null);
					location.querySelectorAll('.cbCommodity').forEach(function(block)
					{
						if (block.closest('.cashBidLocation') !== location) return;
						var heading = block.querySelector('h3.fcControls');
						var match = heading && /^(Corn|Red\s+Wheat|White\s+Wheat|Soybeans)(?:\s+(20\d{2}))?$/i.exec(heading.textContent.trim());
						if (!match) return;
						var key = match[1].toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ');
						(commodities[key] || (commodities[key] = [])).push(
						{
							block: block,
							year: match[2] || ''
						});
					});
					Object.keys(commodities).forEach(function(key)
					{
						var entries = commodities[key];
						var target = entries[0].block;
						var rows = [];
						entries.forEach(function(entry)
						{
							Array.from(entry.block.children).forEach(function(row)
							{
								if (!row.matches('.sevenColumnsBigFirst.fcControls1, .sevenColumnsBigFirst.fcControls2')) return;
								if (!row.dataset.cecCropYear && entry.year) row.dataset.cecCropYear = entry.year;
								// Keep the original delivery text, prices, elements, and chart handlers.
								row.querySelectorAll('.cec-bid-year').forEach(function(prefix)
								{
									prefix.remove();
								});
								rows.push(row);
							});
						});
						rows.sort(function(a, b)
						{
							return Number(a.dataset.cecCropYear || 0) - Number(b.dataset.cecCropYear || 0);
						});
						var heading = target.querySelector('h3.fcControls');
						if (heading.textContent !== labels[key]) heading.textContent = labels[key];
						target.dataset.cecCommodity = key;
						var current = Array.from(target.children).filter(function(node)
						{
							return rows.indexOf(node) !== -1;
						});
						if (current.length !== rows.length || current.some(function(row, index)
							{
								return row !== rows[index];
							}))
						{
							rows.forEach(function(row)
							{
								target.appendChild(row);
							});
						}
						// One native blue heading and one native column header for the whole commodity.
						entries.slice(1).forEach(function(entry)
						{
							entry.block.remove();
						});
					});
				});
			}
			finally
			{
				if (observer) observer.observe(document.body,
				{
					childList: true,
					subtree: true,
					characterData: true
				});
			}
		}

		function schedule()
		{
			if (scheduled) return;
			scheduled = true;
			window.requestAnimationFrame(groupBids);
		}

		function init()
		{
			observer = new MutationObserver(schedule);
			groupBids();
		}
		if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init,
		{
			once: true
		});
		else init();
	})();

</script>

/* Approved QA: apply the shared News header to the native archive. */
(function () {
  'use strict';
  if (!/^\/storyArchives-764\/?$/i.test(window.location.pathname)) return;
  function styleArchive() {
    var category = document.querySelector('.storyCategory');
    if (!category || document.querySelector('.cec-news-archive-header')) return;
    category.classList.add('cec-news-archive');
    var header = document.createElement('header');
    header.className = 'cec-news-feed cec-news-archive-header';
    var inner = document.createElement('div');
    inner.className = 'cec-news-feed__inner';
    var title = document.createElement('h1');
    title.className = 'cec-news-feed__title';
    title.textContent = 'Co-op Updates Archives';
    var intro = document.createElement('p');
    intro.className = 'cec-news-feed__intro';
    intro.textContent = 'Past news and announcements from Cooperative Elevator Company.';
    inner.appendChild(title);
    inner.appendChild(intro);
    header.appendChild(inner);
    category.parentNode.insertBefore(header, category);
    var legacyTitle = category.querySelector('.fcStoryCategoryTitle');
    if (legacyTitle) legacyTitle.hidden = true;
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', styleArchive, { once: true });
  } else {
    styleArchive();
  }
})();
